title: The Jesus Tour – Lisbon 2024
bodyParagraphs: Generally, Camp Lifeguard, also known as the Shepherds’ Camp, is a 3-day training and equipping program for all leaders of our various branches. It provides an environment which conditions leaders to gain knowledge and understanding in that which they have been called to. We come together to learn what true leadership is all about (in and out of CYI) and how to be true Jesus followers who can lead His flock.

Particularly for CLG Europe, we are no different from the above vision. Since we do not always have the privilege of traveling to the headquarters in Ghana for the main CLG, we are blessed to be able to have a mini version right here. Gathering all branches in Europe including other interested people, we hope to replicate a similar environment and experience as from the main camps and have a touch of God to do good.
CYI’s Ahavah is a youth ministry with a vision of reaching out and transforming the lives of young people across the globe.

With this vision, anyone who is young or young at heart is qualified. we have no religious, gender, race or other conditions set for anyone to be able to attend. Anyone attending must simply respect the camp rules and understand that we are Christ people and so we follow Christ principles at camp.
An age restriction is however set to 13years.
So all are invited.
Schedule June 28th – July 2nd in Lille, France *Complete schedule will be sent after registration *Deadline for Registration is April 30, 2024, 23:59
Fees €250 per attendee

title: Oneway Missions in Portugal 2022
bodyParagraphs: One Way Mission Global is the outreach wing of the ministry. We believe that as a ministry we have been saved to serve others and that we have a responsibility of reaching others with the Gospel for Christ. The One Way Missions Global team oversees all mission works done at various levels. Missionary work may vary from one day to two weeks or more.

Going on missions is about the most fulfilling decision anyone can take in his or her life. It does not just involve bringing change to the lives of people and giving them hope but it also includes you the missionary going through major changes and turning points. A lot of people go on missions to bless others and return blessed. Some go to teach and they get taught. God simply adds to the life of a missionary. The most effective mission trips are ones where people understand what they are jumping into so below are a few requirements for joining this missions trip.

1. You must be at least 17years old before or on the first day of missions. 2. You must be ready to commit yourself 100% from the 31st of July to the 8th of August to the missions trip and its activities. 3. You must be willing to put to use all of your skills, abilities and gifts for the betterment of others 4. Missionary trips can be very uncomfortable and humbling. You must be ready to live under any provided condition and to follow instructions. 5. You must complete all training and orientation processes before the first day of missions. Missing any of the mentioned can cause your withdrawal from the trip. 6. Our stories and the transformations we have had are what brings change to many, you must be ready to share your transformation stories, and other life experiences (both good and bad) with the rest of the missionaries and with other people we meet on the mission field. 7. You must be willing to work together with other people and ready to share facility and items with others including rooms, bathrooms, etc. If you do not meet any of these requirements, feel free to discuss with us on how you can develop or get better at them.

title: Marriage Preparation Course
bodyParagraphs: The preparation and foundation for marriage determines one's experience during the marriage. It is one thing preparing for a wedding and another thing preparing for a good marriage.
This is not a counseling session but a marriage school which serves as a foundation for a great counseling session and marriage.
Who Qualifies for this Marriage School?:
1)A couple(a man and a woman) in a serious relationship who are preparing towards getting married in the next year or two.
2)It is open to both CYI and non-CYI members.
Duration for School:
The duration for the program is six (6) meetings and each meeting is going to be for 2 hours. The proposed time for the school is Sunday afternoon after church.
The first session of this school begins on the Sunday 4th February, 2024 and will run for a period of six (6) weeks.
Meetings are going to be physical and not virtual.
